safety_observations.observation: Under the "-- All Sales Leads --" Type control, a Desk Log row carried Source = "Service Dept". The Type control alone does not guarantee a Sales-only population.
safety_observations.implication: Any Sales-only use of Desk Log (or any typed lead list) requires an explicit source-level exclusion of Service; a Type label is insufficient. Leaked/absent Service is excluded, never counted; missing is never zero.

reconciliation.metric: closed deals ÷ write-ups (write-to-close rate), per rooftop, per week
reconciliation.capability_discovered: Deal Performance exposes a candidate write-up-like denominator ("Leads Desked in Timeframe"), a closed count ("Leads Sold"), a "Close %", a parameterized Date Range, and a Sales-only Lead Type selection (Service / Parts Order / Unknown unselected). No native "Write Up"/"Writeup"/"Sales Log"/"Deal Log" report exists.
exact_remaining_requirement: semantic ratification: agree that "Leads Desked" (or "Pencils Desked") is the write-up denominator for write-to-close — the committed frozen_e1_spec numerator/denominator are held and this pass does not resolve them
window acquisition: a dated Sales-only pull of the governed week at all three rooftops (this pass saw only the current MTD default view)

baseline: the trailing-30-day average that the >15%-below comparison is measured against
